As a maintenance & preparation employee for growing locations, you are responsible for maintaining and preparing the growing locations. In this position, you will work both indoors and outdoors and ensure that all growing locations are in optimal condition. You will be involved in preparing new growing locations, carrying out maintenance work, and checking the quality and condition of the substrates and facilities. In addition, you will ensure a neat, safe, and organized working environment. You start your working day at the nursery and see what needs to be done that day. Sometimes you prepare a new growing location, sometimes you work outside on maintenance. You check whether the substrate is good, whether everything is safe, and whether the moss can grow well. 

- You have green fingers or enjoy working outdoors

- You are good with your hands
- You don't mind doing physical work

In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together. 
As a Supply Chain Order Picker, you will work with your own picking trolley equipped with crates in which you collect customer orders. You will use a handheld scanner in combination with a voice-picking system. During a comprehensive training session on your first working day, you will learn how to use this system.
